§6Australium§f

§aA stable, naturally occurring trans-schrabidic element. Looks like gold. Acts like a fission fuel.§f

§bAustralium§f is a fictional ultra-heavy element that is fully stable yet undergoes fission. Visually gold-like. There is a mineral deposit at §eX: -400, Z: -400§f with ~490 average yield, but smelting gives only 1 nugget per ore. Shred first for 2 powders, then smelt.

§6Make It§f:
§b•§f §bCyclotron§f: Tennessine Powder + Plutonium Dust -> §eAustralium Powder§f
§b•§f Mineral deposit at -400,-400 (finite, ~490 avg)

§6SILEX§f (9.0x multiplier, BiSmUTh crystal):
§b•§f §bLesser Australium Nugget§f, §e83.3%§f
§b•§f §bGreater Australium Nugget§f, §e16.6%§f, used as RBMK fuel

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f Market Gardener, shovel that crits on rocket jumps or falls
§b•§f Mark III Life Extender, armor mod
§b•§f Greater isotope as RBMK fuel

§ePS:§f The cyclotron setup is more reliable than the finite deposit. Tennessine comes from earlier cyclotron recipes, so you may already have the chain running.
